_comment: Cross-port YAML divergences ledgered as known-gap (the runner treats listed fixtures as passing). yaml-quoted-leading-zero: Java's pipeline strips the quotes on '"007"' so the canonical output reads the value as int 7 instead of string "007". TS yaml, PyYAML, YamlDotNet all preserve the quoted form; Java's desugar/canonical path silently re-coerces. Cross-port reference TS produces `@column: "007"`; Java produces `@column: 7`. Tracks the lib-vs-pipeline divergence; reconcile by quoting-preservation fix in Java.
